_meta.batch: Tadpole CLUE X (~53 sceny, 308 terminow) - reakcje Tadpole (nurkini, luzny bezposredni rejestr) na kazdy dowod w grze.

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ActionFigure/S.en: You know... I think [h]I'd[/h] make a pretty good action figure.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ActionFigure/S.pl: Wiecie... myślę, że [h]ja[/h] byłabym całkiem niezłą figurką akcji.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ActionFigure/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ActionFigure/S.en: Maybe a bath toy? With little legs that kick when you wind me up?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ActionFigure/S.pl: Może zabawka do kąpieli? Z małymi nóżkami, które kopią, kiedy mnie nakręcisz?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ActionFigure/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BalloonBasket/.en: Gripp's got his brand figured out, huh? Kind of an 18th century, vaudeville, aeronaut vibe?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BalloonBasket/.pl: Gripp ma ogarniętą swoją markę, co? Taki klimat XVIII-wiecznego wodewilu i aeronauty?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BalloonBasket/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BalloonBasket/.en: Even just the choice to use the word [i]'emporium'[/i]...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BalloonBasket/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.en: There's no way all this kicked off over an empty box.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.pl: Nie ma mowy, żeby to wszystko zaczęło się od pustego pudełka.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.en: S'far as I know, that box is a [h]very[/h] recent addition to the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.pl: O ile wiem, to pudełko to [h]bardzo[/h] niedawny dodatek do łodzi podwodnej.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.en: I think it may have been the catalyst that lead to Mortuga's murder.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.pl: Myślę, że mogło być katalizatorem, który doprowadził do morderstwa Mortugi.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.en: Now I [h]really[/h] wanna know what's inside.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.pl: Teraz [h]naprawdę[/h] chcę wiedzieć, co jest w środku.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlackBox/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: -is that [h]you[/h] in the photo, Miss Tadpole?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: -czy to [h]ty[/h] jesteś na zdjęciu, panno Tadpole?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: No. I'm not that buff, and my beard isn't that thick-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: Nie. Nie jestem taka umięśniona, a moja broda nie jest tak gęsta-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: She looks [h]just[/h] like you, except she has long hair... and a mermaid tail.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: Wygląda [h]dokładnie[/h] jak ty, tylko że ma długie włosy... i ogon syreny.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: It's a fake tail - I don't wear it anymore, it actually slowed me down.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: To sztuczny ogon - już go nie noszę, tak naprawdę mnie spowalniał.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.en: Not that I could really swim in that little ball anyway...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.pl: Nie żebym w ogóle mogła pływać w tej małej kuli...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BlurryPhoto/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: Sinthia mentioned the ship's compass broke...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: Sinthia wspomniała, że kompas statku się zepsuł...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: Looks like Gripp's in the middle of fixing it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: Wygląda na to, że Gripp jest w trakcie naprawiania go.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: Did Sinthia say exactly [h]how[/h] it broke? Or what was wrong with it?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.pl: Czy Sinthia powiedziała dokładnie, [h]jak[/h] się zepsuł? Albo co było z nim nie tak?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.en: She just said it was [i]'acting erratically.'[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE BrokenCompass/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: It's custom made - see the 'S' emblem on the epaulettes? And on the back?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsJacket.pl: Zrobiona na zamówienie - widzisz godło 'S' na naramiennikach? I na plecach?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsJacket.en: I guess she'd rather keep it preserved.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsJacket.pl: Chyba wolałaby ją zachować w dobrym stanie.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsJacket.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: Magnus really wasn't one for record-keeping...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: Magnus naprawdę nie był typem, co prowadzi zapiski...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: Looks like it's just each time someone [i]new[/i] arrives on the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: Wygląda na to, że to po prostu za każdym razem, kiedy ktoś [i]nowy[/i] przybywa na łódź podwodną.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: That makes sense - he was always people focused.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: To ma sens - zawsze był skupiony na ludziach.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.en: Human interactions, relationships... it's what he considered most important.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.pl: Interakcje międzyludzkie, relacje... to uważał za najważniejsze.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaptainsLog/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaretakersJour.en: Do you recognise any of these objects?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaretakersJour.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaretakersJour.en:
[i]The Mermaid's Tongue...
Rumored to be lost at sea...[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaretakersJour.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaretakersJour.en: Maybe Zephyr was trying to get [i]hold[/i] of it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaretakersJour.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: Sinthia had to ask my help when writing this up - she wanted to put Magnus's age, but she didn't know it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Sinthia musiała poprosić mnie o pomoc przy pisaniu tego - chciała wpisać wiek Magnusa, ale go nie znała.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: He and I were friends. I was really trying to get to know him...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: On i ja byliśmy przyjaciółmi. Naprawdę starałam się go poznać...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: Sounds like that might've been kind of an uphill struggle?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Brzmi, jakby to mogła być trochę walka pod górkę?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.en: Yeah. He didn't really like to talk about himself.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.pl: Tak. Naprawdę nie lubił mówić o sobie.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CaseFile/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CellPhone/Sect.en: I kinda wish Dirk hadn't brought that onto the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CellPhone/Sect.pl: Trochę żałuję, że Dirk w ogóle to przywiózł na łódź podwodną.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CellPhone/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CellPhone/Sect.en: Feels like it breaks some unspoken rule - having contact with the outside world...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CellPhone/Sect.pl: Czuję, że to łamie jakąś niepisaną zasadę - kontakt ze światem zewnętrznym...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CellPhone/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.en: Looks like Mortuga chose to use a [i]typewriter[/i] for this...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.pl: Wygląda na to, że Mortuga zdecydował się użyć do tego [i]maszyny do pisania...[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.en: It's more that he didn't like writing by hand. He'd even sometimes ask [i]me[/i] to write things for him.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.pl: To bardziej to, że nie lubił pisać ręcznie. Czasem prosił nawet [i]mnie,[/i] żebym coś dla niego napisała.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.en: To make it more official, maybe?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.en:
Oh-
Just little notes, you know.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.pl:
Och-
Po prostu małe notatki, wiesz.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CommandContrac.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: All I can say for sure, is that at one time, this cauldron spent several years [i]underwater.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: Jedyne, co mogę powiedzieć na pewno, to że w pewnym momencie ten kocioł spędził kilka lat [i]pod wodą.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: Not just underwater, but in the [i]ocean[/i] - I can tell by the growth of the barnacles and algae.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: Nie tylko pod wodą, ale w [i]oceanie[/i] - poznaję po naroślach pąkli i alg.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.en: There's no growth on the inside, though. Or on the lid.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.pl: Ale w środku nie ma żadnych narośli. Ani na wieku.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE CurseCauldron/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DivingLicense/.en: [i]'Ocean Rescue Divers Association'.[/i] Is this an organisation you used to work for?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DivingLicense/.pl: [i]'Stowarzyszenie Nurków Ratowniczych Oceanu'.[/i] Czy to organizacja, dla której kiedyś pracowałaś?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DivingLicense/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DreamHelmet/Se.en: This pattern looks a bit like a dreamcatcher.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DreamHelmet/Se.pl: Ten wzór wygląda trochę jak łapacz snów.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DreamHelmet/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DreamHelmet/Se.en: It's something you hang in your bedroom window when you're a teenage girl.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DreamHelmet/Se.pl: To coś, co wieszasz w oknie sypialni, kiedy jesteś nastoletnią dziewczyną.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DreamHelmet/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.en: If you watch him closely, Gripp holds this tighter whenever he gets sad or nervous...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.pl: Jeśli obserwujesz go uważnie, Gripp trzyma to mocniej, kiedy robi się smutny albo zdenerwowany...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.en: Sounds like you've really been [i]staring[/i] at him.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.pl: Brzmi, jakbyś naprawdę się w niego [i]wpatrywała.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.en: ...and only lets go of it when he's totally at ease.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.pl: ...i puszcza to dopiero, kiedy jest zupełnie spokojny.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.en: Yeah, well, you can learn a lot watching someone's involuntary movements.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.pl: No cóż, można się wiele nauczyć, obserwując czyjeś mimowolne ruchy.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.en: You're tired. Achy. You only got an hour of sleep - on a hard surface.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.pl: Jesteś zmęczona. Obolała. Spałaś tylko godzinę - na twardej powierzchni.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE DriftwoodCane/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: There it is - on the left hand side, in the big tank of water.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Oto i on - po lewej stronie, w wielkim zbiorniku z wodą.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: What [i]is[/i] it? Some kind of sea creature?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: I think it's the reason they built the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Myślę, że to powód, dla którego zbudowali łódź podwodną.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: They built a submarine to house a [i]sea creature?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Zbudowali łódź podwodną, żeby pomieścić [i]stworzenie morskie?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: I don't understand, where would it [i]live?[/i] Wouldn't it need to be in [i]water?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Nie rozumiem, gdzie by [i]mieszkało?[/i] Czy nie musiałoby być w [i]wodzie?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: Yeah. There's a special area of submarine that can fill up with seawater.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Tak. Jest specjalny obszar łodzi podwodnej, który można wypełnić wodą morską.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.en: You're standing on top of it, right this second.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.pl: Stoisz właśnie na nim, w tej sekundzie.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FamilyPhoto/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: You know, I think this painting is the answer.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Wiecie, myślę, że ten obraz to odpowiedź.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: Everything. Magnus Mortuga, what he was doing, what he was thinking...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Na wszystko. Magnus Mortuga, co robił, o czym myślał...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: Even, maybe - how and why he died.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: Nawet, może - jak i czemu umarł.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.en: [i]I swear - there's [h]always[/h] a painting with a secret in it.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.pl: [i]Przysięgam - [h]zawsze[/h] jest jakiś obraz z sekretem w środku.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FeliciaPaintin.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FilmProjector/.en: Although, presumably he got it from someone else.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FilmProjector/.pl: Chociaż, zapewne dostał to od kogoś innego.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FilmProjector/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.en: That belongs to Sym, I'm pretty sure.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.pl: To należy do Sym, jestem prawie pewna.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.en: It's something to do with her old magic act.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.pl: To ma coś wspólnego z jej dawnym numerem magicznym.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.en: You might be right, but we found it in Zephyr's [i]Dream Chamber.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.pl: Możesz mieć rację, ale znaleźliśmy to w [i]Komnacie Snów[/i] Zephyra.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.en: [i]Still?[/i] I told him to give all her stuff back.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.pl: [i]Wciąż?[/i] Mówiłam mu, żeby oddał jej wszystkie rzeczy.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.en: I'll have to have a word with him.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE FogBall/Sectio.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: We just - found it - lying around in a corridor. What is it?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.pl: Po prostu - znaleźliśmy to - leżało w korytarzu. Co to jest?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: It's Magnus's [i]key.[/i] It unlocks his cabin.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: Yeah. You just gotta - [i]push the iris...[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: ...and the key pops out the back. See?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: So, you need this to lock or unlock the Captain's Cabin?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.pl: Więc potrzebujesz tego, żeby zamknąć albo otworzyć Kajutę Kapitana?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: Uh-huh. Magnus only locked that door on rare occasions, but whenever he did - he used this key.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.pl: Aha. Magnus zamykał te drzwi tylko w rzadkich przypadkach, ale kiedy to robił - używał tego klucza.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.en: Down the hall from the Parlor - at the very back of the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.pl: W dół korytarza od Salonu - na samym tyle łodzi podwodnej.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GlassEyeball/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: I'm surprised Sym let you see it, she's normally pretty guarded about it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GoldenLocket/S.pl: Dziwię się, że Sym pozwoliła wam to zobaczyć, zwykle jest z tym dość skryta.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: Uh  - it's some kind of family [i]heirloom[/i], I think?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GoldenLocket/S.en: Do you know why she [i]wears[/i] it all the time?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE GoldenLocket/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HandheldRadio/.en: It's a radio... dressed up like a little doll...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HandheldRadio/.pl: To radio... przebrane za małą lalkę...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HandheldRadio/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HandheldRadio/.en: Do you know who it's supposed to [i]be?[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HandheldRadio/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HandwrittenLet.en: I don't know anything about that.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HandwrittenLet.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: Any idea what Zephyr's keeping in this bottle...?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Masz pojęcie, co Zephyr trzyma w tej butelce...?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: Every evening, he comes by the Airlock and empties the bottle into the water tank below.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Każdego wieczoru przychodzi do Śluzy Powietrznej i opróżnia butelkę do zbiornika wodnego poniżej.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: ...and the water tank leads out into the ocean?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: Yeah. And then each morning, he comes by with the empty bottle and fills it back up again.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Tak. A potem każdego ranka przychodzi z pustą butelką i napełnia ją z powrotem.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: Whatever it is, he dumps it into the ocean every single night.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Cokolwiek to jest, wyrzuca to do oceanu każdej nocy.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.en: I've never managed to work it out.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.pl: Nigdy nie udało mi się tego rozgryźć.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexBottle/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.en: So the main character's inspired by Magnus Mortuga...?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.pl: Więc główny bohater jest inspirowany Magnusem Mortugą...?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.en: I think so. But Wirman changed his name to 'Markus Mordoom'.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.pl: Chyba tak. Ale Wirman zmienił jego imię na 'Markus Mordoom'.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE HexoftheHelmsm.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: I saw posters just like this up on the walls in Fortuna Hall...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: Widziałam takie same plakaty na ścianach w Fortuna Hall...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: You went to see Symmetry's show?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: No - by the time I came through the town, she'd already left.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: Nie - zanim przejeżdżałam przez miasteczko, ona już wyjechała.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: But her posters were still up?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: Yeah, the owner was scrambling to find something new. I don't think she wanted to admit she'd lost her star act.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: Tak, właścicielka gorączkowo szukała czegoś nowego. Nie sądzę, żeby chciała przyznać, że straciła swoją gwiazdę programu.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: And - did she ever find a new show?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: Uh, no. It didn't work out.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.en: The theatre owner, that's, uh - Baroness Fortuna?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.pl: Właścicielka teatru, to, yy - Baronowa Fortuna?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IllusionistPos.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en: That's where [h]Magnus[/h] lived - back before the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl: Tam mieszkał [h]Magnus[/h] - jeszcze przed łodzią podwodną.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en: He lived in the [h]Inn?[/h] But - he wasn't part of the Stonetop family, surely?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl: Mieszkał w [h]Gospodzie?[/h] Ale - chyba nie był częścią rodziny Stonetop?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.en: No - I don't think he had [h]any[/h] family in the town.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.pl: Nie - nie sądzę, żeby miał [h]jakąkolwiek[/h] rodzinę w miasteczku.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE InnDeeds/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.en: Reckon you could pick it up? You're pretty strong, right?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.pl: Myślisz, że mogłabyś to podnieść? Jesteś dość silna, prawda?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.en: Probably. But he had real big arms, like me.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.pl: Pewnie. Ale on miał naprawdę wielkie ramiona, jak ja.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.en: I could maybe get my [h]arms[/h] around it, just about...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.pl: Może udałoby mi się objąć to [h]ramionami,[/h] tak jakoś...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.en: But for anyone else, it'd be a two person job?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.pl: Ale dla kogokolwiek innego, to byłaby robota dla dwóch osób?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE IronBell/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.en: I never had dolls as a child.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.pl: Nigdy nie miałam lalek jako dziecko.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.en: The closest thing I had were frogs I'd catch from a pond. I'd give them names and try to make friends with them.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.pl: Najbliższe temu były żaby, które łapałam ze stawu. Nadawałam im imiona i próbowałam się z nimi zaprzyjaźnić.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.en: Ahh, the best things in life are free.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.pl: Achh, najlepsze rzeczy w życiu są za darmo.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE LifesizeDoll/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: I feel like I know what this is.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.pl: Mam wrażenie, że wiem, co to jest.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: The thing in the painting - you've seen it?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.pl: Ta rzecz na obrazie - widziałaś to?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.en:
Not seen it.
More like... felt it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.pl:
Nie widziałam.
Bardziej jakby... to poczuła.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: I'm pretty sure it's out there. Maybe even right now.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.pl: Jestem prawie pewna, że to gdzieś tam jest. Może nawet teraz.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.en: Should we be worried about this?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MermaidPaintin.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.en: Where did you get this [i]bottle[/i] from?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.en: I found it in the ocean, like everything else in here.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.pl: Znalazłam ją w oceanie, jak wszystko inne tutaj.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.en: Of course, I never go [i]too[/i] far out.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.en: Are you gonna open it up?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.en: [i]No way,[/i] it's a message in a bottle-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.en: -if I [i]opened[/i] it, it'd just be a message [h]and[/h] a bottle. Not nearly as interesting.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.pl: -gdybym to [i]otworzyła,[/i] to byłaby po prostu wiadomość [h]i[/h] butelka. Wcale nie tak interesujące.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MessageinaBott.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: Magnus carved and painted it himself, so it's very specific to his life.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: Magnus sam to wyrzeźbił i pomalował, więc jest to bardzo specyficzne dla jego życia.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: It basically only shows the buildings and people that were relevant to him.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: Zasadniczo pokazuje tylko budynki i ludzi, którzy byli dla niego ważni.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: I noticed Mortuga [i]himself[/i] isn't on there...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: Zauważyłem, że samego Mortugi tam [i]nie ma...[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.en: No... I think he's somewhere else.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.pl: Nie... myślę, że jest gdzie indziej.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ModelTown/Sect.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: This was on the floor of the crime scene-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl: To leżało na podłodze miejsca zbrodni-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en:
We don't [h]know[/h] that.
We don't know [h]what[/h] it is.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl:
Nie [h]wiemy[/h] tego.
Nie wiemy, [h]czym[/h] to jest.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: Doesn't make any [i]sense[/i] for it to be poison-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl: Nie ma [i]sensu,[/i] żeby to była trucizna-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: Magnus was killed with a blade. Something sharp.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl: Magnus został zabity ostrzem. Czymś ostrym.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: -but there wasn't anything like that at the crime scene.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.pl: -ale na miejscu zbrodni nie było niczego takiego.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: Well then it must be somewhere else.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.en: Do you know what it is?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MoonVial/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: Yeah, see - [i]this[/i] what I'm talking about-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.pl: Tak, widzicie - [i]to[/i] właśnie mam na myśli-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: Dirk looks [h]way[/h] better like that. The beard, the long hair, the outfit-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.pl: Dirk wygląda [h]dużo[/h] lepiej w ten sposób. Broda, długie włosy, strój-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: I can't help it if I have a type.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.pl: Nic na to nie poradzę, że mam swój typ.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.en: You like the rugged pirate look, huh?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE MovieMagazine/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.en:
Symmetry had it.
Does it not [i]belong[/i] to her?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl:
Symmetry to miała.
Czy to nie [i]należy[/i] do niej?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Just the front page? Or did he have the whole newspaper?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Tylko pierwsza strona? Czy miał całą gazetę?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.en: Why's he so interested in Sym's old magic act?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.pl: Czemu jest tak zainteresowany dawnym numerem magicznym Sym?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE NewspaperPage/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Pocketbook/Sec.en: What's this [i]symbol[/i] on the front? Looks like someone scratched it in with a [i]claw[/i] or something...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Pocketbook/Sec.pl: Co to za [i]symbol[/i] z przodu? Wygląda, jakby ktoś wydrapał to [i]pazurem[/i] czy czymś...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Pocketbook/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.en: I'm pretty sure Magnus kept this in the store room...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.pl: Jestem prawie pewna, że Magnus trzymał to w magazynie...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.en: He had it covering the cauldron, I guess?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.en: Just to protect it from... dust?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.en: Or maybe he was specifically keeping it [i]hidden...[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE RaggedCloth/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.en: That drawing of the coral - it looks familiar...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.en: Oh it's a - just a generic piece of red [i]coral[/i] - isn't it?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.pl: Och, to - po prostu zwykły kawałek czerwonego [i]koralowca[/i] - prawda?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.en: It reminds me of a piece I found in the [i]ocean[/i] recently...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.pl: Przypomina mi kawałek, który znalazłam ostatnio w [i]oceanie...[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.en: Can I see it? Do you still [i]have[/i] it?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SeaChart/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.en: I'm pretty sure Magnus carved this himself.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.pl: Jestem prawie pewna, że Magnus sam to wyrzeźbił.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.en: I know one way you could get it [h]out[/h] of the bottle.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.pl: Znam jeden sposób, żeby wyciągnąć to [h]z[/h] butelki.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.en: No idea how he got it into the bottle, though...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.pl: Nie mam pojęcia, jak wsadził to do środka, chociaż...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.en: Trick of the trade, I guess.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipinaBottle/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.en: Magnus used to let me steer. He even taught me how to do it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.pl: Magnus pozwalał mi kiedyś sterować. Nawet mnie tego nauczył.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.en: Sounds like he was setting you up to be the next captain.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.pl: Brzmi, jakby przygotowywał cię na następnego kapitana.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE ShipsWheel/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.en: Let's see... Magnus, Gripp, Wirman, Sinthia... oh - and Sym.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.pl: Zobaczmy... Magnus, Gripp, Wirman, Sinthia... och - i Sym.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.en: Those five are from the town. Or - they lived there for a while, at least.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.pl: Ta piątka jest z miasteczka. Albo - przynajmniej mieszkali tam przez jakiś czas.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.en: You think they all knew each other from before the submarine?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.pl: Myślisz, że wszyscy znali się jeszcze przed łodzią podwodną?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.en: Magnus and [i]Gripp[/i] knew each other, I think...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SilkwirmMap/Se.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.en: I... just assumed it was waterlogged - from the bilgewater.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.pl: Ja... po prostu założyłam, że jest zalane wodą - z zęzy.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.en: How did you know we found it in the bilge?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.pl: Skąd wiedziałaś, że znaleźliśmy to w zęzie?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.en: Because it smells. And it's still wet.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.pl: Bo śmierdzi. I wciąż jest mokre.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.en:
Oh yeah. Ew.
-Sally, you take it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.pl:
O tak. Fuj.
-Sally, ty to weź.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE StrangeDevice/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.en: I guess now that Sinthia's captain, she wants an up-to-date blueprint of the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.pl: Sądzę, że teraz, kiedy Sinthia jest kapitanem, chce aktualnego planu łodzi podwodnej.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.en: Why was there an [h]out[/h] of date blueprint??
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.en: The ship has kind of a complex history...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.en: She's been through a few different phases... lived through a few rough patches.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.pl: Przeszła przez kilka różnych faz... przetrwała parę trudnych okresów.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SubmarineBluep.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.en: Dirk tried to get me to take these...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.pl: Dirk próbował namówić mnie, żebym to brała...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.en: He's convinced we've all got a Vitamin D deficiency.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.pl: Jest przekonany, że wszyscy mamy niedobór witaminy D.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.en: He said that's why everyone on the submarine is, in his words; [i]'moody and weird'.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.pl: Powiedział, że dlatego wszyscy na łodzi podwodnej są, jego słowami; [i]'humorzaści i dziwni'.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE SunTablets/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: I really don't know why Wirman brought that bulky old thing with him.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: Naprawdę nie wiem, czemu Wirman przywiózł ze sobą to nieporęczne, stare graty.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: Maybe the typewriter's got some kind of [i]sentimental[/i] value.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: Może maszyna do pisania ma jakąś [i]sentymentalną[/i] wartość.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: It [i]must[/i] do - otherwise he'd upgrade to something more modern.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: [i]Musi[/i] mieć - inaczej przesiadłby się na coś nowocześniejszego.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: That's no way to talk about Dirk.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: Tak się nie mówi o Dirku.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.en: I don't doubt he could afford it.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.pl: Nie wątpię, że byłoby go stać.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE Typewriter/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: Tadpole... is this a photo of [h]you?[/h]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: It's just - it's an [i]underwater[/i] photo... and it kinda looks like a woman's face, I just thought-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl: Po prostu - to zdjęcie [i]podwodne...[/i] i trochę wygląda jak twarz kobiety, po prostu pomyślałam-
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: All mysterious underwater women look alike, is that it?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl: Wszystkie tajemnicze podwodne kobiety wyglądają tak samo, o to chodzi?
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en:
For the record;
[h]I[/h] don't think it looks like you.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.pl:
Tak dla wiadomości;
[h]Ja[/h] nie sądzę, żeby to wyglądało jak ty.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.en: In fact, it doesn't look like [i]anyone.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE UnderwaterPhot.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: Magnus wouldn't bring this inside the submarine...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Magnus nie wnosiłby tego do środka łodzi podwodnej...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: ...but he didn't seem to want to get [i]rid[/i] of it either.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: ...ale nie wyglądało też na to, żeby chciał się tego [i]pozbyć.[/i]
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: So, it must have some kind of purpose.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: We already [h]know[/h] what it does - we saw it on the way in.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Już [h]wiemy,[/h] co to robi - widzieliśmy to w drodze tutaj.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.en: It shines a big green light so you know where to go to find the submarine.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.pl: Świeci wielkim zielonym światłem, żebyś wiedział, gdzie iść, żeby znaleźć łódź podwodną.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.en: Mariana's like a little mole, digging around for worms...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.pl: Mariana jest jak mały kret, wygrzebujący robaki...
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.en: I can't imagine what she'd get on me - I don't have any secrets.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.pl: Nie wyobrażam sobie, co by na mnie znalazła - nie mam żadnych sekretów.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.en: ...except the worms are other people's secrets.
Conversation/Tadpole CLUE WoodenPipe/Sec.speaker: Tadpole
